details.description: The code uses crypto.pbkdf2Sync which performs a CPU-bound operation on the event loop. This can block the event loop and enable DoS or performance degradation in asynchronous systems.
details.fix_explanation: Replace the synchronous PBKDF2 call with an asynchronous implementation (crypto.pbkdf2) so the event loop is not blocked.
details.secure_code_snippet: // use crypto.pbkdf2 with a Promise wrapper (async) to avoid blocking the event loop

details.vulnerability_type: No minimum PBKDF2 iterations / weak hash parameters
details.description: The password verification did not require a minimum iteration count; a very low iteration value would make password hashes easy to brute force.
details.fix_explanation: Enforce a reasonable minimum iteration count for PBKDF2 (e.g., 100,000) and refuse verification for hashes with fewer iterations.
details.secure_code_snippet: const MIN_PBKDF2_ITERATIONS = 100000; if (iterations < MIN_PBKDF2_ITERATIONS) return false;

details.description: The login function returned early for mismatched usernames without performing the same expensive password verification, allowing an attacker to distinguish valid usernames by response time.
details.fix_explanation: Always perform password verification or an equivalent delay to make response time independent of whether the username is valid.
details.secure_code_snippet:
// ensure verifyPassword is awaited for both valid and invalid usernames to equalize timing
await verifyPassword(pass, adminHash); // regardless of user equality

details.vulnerability_type: Leaking environment variable names in errors
details.description: getEnv threw an error message containing the name of the missing environment variable which may leak internal configuration details into logs/monitoring/stack traces.
details.fix_explanation: Avoid exposing exact environment variable names in production errors. Provide the detailed name only in development mode.
details.secure_code_snippet: if (!v) { if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') throw new Error(\`Missing required environment variable: ${name}\`); throw new Error('Missing required environment variable'); }

details.vulnerability_type: Unsanitized PRIVATE_KEY_PATH (path traversal / unsafe file path)
details.description: getPrivateKeyPath returned raw environment-supplied paths without validation. Callers could be tricked into reading unexpected files if path traversal values are used.
details.fix_explanation: Normalize and validate the path; reject upward-traversal sequences and prefer reading private keys from a secured store or an explicitly allowed base directory.
details.secure_code_snippet: const normalized = path.normalize(p); if (normalized.includes('..')) return undefined; return normalized;
